reservationDetails.title: ℹ️ Important reservation information
items: Reservations possible by phone or online via TheFork (evening service only).
Outside these times, walk-ins are welcome, we always try to find you a table.
Maximum reservation capacity: 8 people, subject to availability.
No reservations are taken by email or voicemail.
Only complete tables will be seated. Please wait outside and present yourselves when your whole party has arrived.
Tables are no longer held after the reservation time.
Seating is done in order of reservations. Thank you for your understanding.

home.title: Comme un Bouillon
home.subtitle: Traditional French cuisine in the heart of Paris

intro.paragraph1: A few steps from the Opéra Garnier, in the heart of Paris's 2nd arrondissement, Comme un Bouillon welcomes you in a warm and authentic atmosphere.
intro.paragraph2: Inspired by famous Parisian bouillons, our restaurant, open since June 2021, offers traditional French cuisine: generous, simple and homemade dishes at affordable prices.
intro.paragraph3: Every morning we receive fresh produce to guarantee you a tasty plate, served quickly and with a smile.
intro.paragraph4: And because we like to do things ourselves, even the decor was designed and made by hand to create a unique atmosphere.
